name: How can I ensure my playroom addition is safe for children?

mainEntity.name: How can I ensure my playroom addition is safe for children?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensuring safety in a playroom addition involves careful planning of materials, fixtures, and overall layout. This includes selecting non-toxic paints, rounded corners on built-ins, secure window treatments, and appropriate electrical outlet covers. We emphasize safety in our designs, particularly in family-focused communities like Pleasanton and Danville. A first-party insight from Hometelligent is our use of robust building practices to meet or exceed safety codes, focusing on durable and secure construction that withstands active play. Discussing specific safety concerns during the design phase is crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure playroom safety by using non-toxic materials, rounded edges, and secure fixtures. We incorporate robust building practices to meet or exceed safety codes.
